name: West Liberty University
oos_note: Public university. Non-resident (out-of-state) undergraduate base tuition & fees $9,420/semester x 2 = $18,840/year, academic year 2026-27, from West Liberty University Business Office undergraduate tuition page (westliberty.edu/business-office/tuition-fees/undergraduate-tuition/). In-state annual on same page is $9,414, matching the known in-state figure, confirming same tuition & fees basis (excludes room/board).
